pages.text: The zoo gates close with a click. Milo the meerkat stands up tall to look.
The elephants sway and hum a low, slow song. Shh. Sleepy time.
The giraffes fold their long, long legs. Shh. Sleepy time.
The lions yawn big, gold yawns. Then they flop down in a heap.
The penguins huddle close, close, close.
The monkeys stop swinging. They hang in the tree, quiet at last.
The hippo sinks into the warm water until only two ears show.
The parrots tuck their bright feathers away.
The tortoise pulls his head in. Goodnight, tortoise.
The night lamps glow along the empty path.
Milo scurries home to his burrow and his brothers and sisters.
Everyone in the zoo is asleep. Shh. Sleepy time, Milo.
